job.title: Database Administrator
job.description:
Database Administrator (DBA) – Raiser’s Edge

Medical Research Sector | Sydney | Hybrid

Join a team that is driving life-changing medical research.

Our client is seeking a Database Administrator (DBA) – Raiser’s Edge to play a pivotal role in supporting fundraising and marketing efforts through expert database management.

If you’re passionate about data integrity, process optimisation, and leveraging insights to make a real impact, this role is for you.

Why This Role?
  • Make a Difference: Your work will directly support groundbreaking medical research and fundraising efforts that improve lives.
  • Technical Growth: Work with a dynamic team, leveraging Raiser’s Edge, SQL, and Power BI.
  • Collaborative Environment: Partner with marketing, fundraising, and senior stakeholders to drive data strategy and best practices.
  • Hybrid & Flexible Work: Enjoy a balance between remote and in-office work in Sydney.
What You’ll Do:
  • Support marketing and fundraising campaigns with targeted data segmentation using Raiser’s Edge and SQL queries.
  • Manage data imports and integrity, ensuring best practice standards.
  • Drive data quality improvements across CRM and other platforms.
  • Work with third-party consultancies on automation and API integrations.
  • Contribute to the organisation’s 5-year data strategy, collaborating with senior stakeholders.
What We’re Looking For:
  • 3+ years’ experience in data management, ideally with Raiser’s Edge or similar CRM.
  • Strong SQL database skills with the ability to build and export complex queries.
  • A critical thinker with analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills to explain data processes effectively.
  • A proactive approach to improving data procedures and analytics knowledge.
Desirable Skills:
  • Experience with business insights and analytics.
  • Exposure to Python for data automation and reporting.
Ready to Apply? If you’re a database expert looking to use your skills for a greater cause, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now and be part of a mission-driven organisation that’s changing lives through medical research.
Apply Today!
